dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pfjc](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pfjc) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Feb 23 2025 20km S of Shortland Harbour. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -7.2681 longitude 155.8242. It impacted 2303 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
